name: devmesh
description: An evidence-based AI software engineering, website-operations, and agency-operations orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, WordPress, IDX/MLS/RESO, multi-site fleet management, monitoring, tickets, SLAs, CRM/lead operations, client lifecycle, and reporting.

interface.shortDescription: AI engineering + Agency Website Operations Mission Control
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v1.1 adds an Agency Operations Control Center for multi-client website fleets: scheduled health monitoring, domain/SSL expiry, staged WordPress update waves, staging-to-production promotion, change and visual history, plugin vulnerability maintenance watch, license renewals, client access inventory, ticket intake, SLA priority, lead SLA, real-estate CRM integration, MLS provider health, privacy/cookie auditing, continuous accessibility, content QA, and client onboarding/offboarding. It builds on v1.0 Website Operations, WordPress Real Estate, IDX/MLS/RESO, Mission Control, Browser QA, security, performance, CI, deployment, incident response, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Agency Deep: audit all client websites, prioritize incidents and maintenance, and create a site-specific action queue with evidence.
DevMesh Agency: onboard this client website, inventory access and stack, establish baselines, and identify operational gaps without storing secrets.
DevMesh Agency: monitor this WordPress real-estate fleet for uptime, SSL/domain expiry, plugin risk, IDX/MLS freshness, lead delivery, CRM health, and SLA breaches.
